title: Shivchem Agro IPO Details
intro:
Shivchem Agro IPO is a book build issue of ₹14.01 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 22.60 lakh shares of ₹14.01 crore.

Shivchem Agro IPO opens for subscription on Sep 28, 2026 and closes on Sep 30, 2026. The allotment for the Shivchem Agro IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 1, 2026. Shivchem Agro IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 6, 2026.

Shivchem Agro IPO is set issue price band at ₹59 to ₹62 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,48,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,72,000.

Shannon Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Shivchem Agro IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2021, Shivchem Agro is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22000:2018, and ISO 31000:2018 certified agrochemical company based in India. The company manufactures stock, distribute, and sell a wide range of agricultural formulations, including insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, plant growth regulators, rodenticides, and fertilizers. These products are available in both solid (powders) and liquid (emulsifiable concentrates) forms, helping farmers improve crop protection and productivity.

The company is licensed under the Insecticides Act, 1968 to manufacture 176 agrochemical products—88 insecticides, 40 fungicides, 37 herbicides, 8 plant growth regulators, and 3 rodenticides—approved by the Central Insecticides Board and Registration Committee (CIBRC), Haryana. It is also authorized to manufacture 82 fertilizers under the Fertilizer Control Order, 1985.

The company is licensed to sell and distribute our products in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha, Assam, and Madhya Pradesh, with a network of 516 distributors and 6 godowns across these states as of March 31, 2025.

Manufacturing facility: Its manufacturing facility in Jhajjar, Haryana, is equipped with modern machinery and pollution control systems, including an Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) and a Wet Scrubber Unit.
As on August 31, 2025, its total workforce has 59 permanent employees.

faqs.question: How to apply in Shivchem Agro IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Shivchem Agro IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Shivchem Agro IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Shivchem Agro IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Shivchem Agro IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Shivchem Agro IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
